points.description: States unbiasedness (expected value of the estimator equals the true parameter).
points.partial_credit: Name only without the idea is still accepted; vague or slightly wrong wording gets half.

points.description: States consistency (estimator converges to the true parameter as sample size increases).
States sufficiency (estimator uses all information in the sample about the parameter).

rubric.notes: Award 0.5 for each of the four properties named (unbiased, consistent, efficient, sufficient); clear synonyms such as "minimum variance" for efficiency are accepted. Total is the sum, rounded to a whole mark by the marker if needed (e.g. 3 correct = 1.5, round to 1 or 2 per exam practice). Wrong or unrelated properties earn nothing but do not remove marks for correct ones.
